scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @chargewise/backend" "npm run dev -w @chargewise/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chargewise/backend && npm run build -w @chargewise/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chargewise/backend && npm run test -w @chargewise/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chargewise/backend && npm run typecheck -w @chargewise/frontend
